source.connections: Only same-family downstream endpoints within 1 m of an actual source river line are connected. Receiving lines are split at those junctions. No nearest-river routing across drainage divides.
source.direction: Source M values increase downstream; calibrated against Glomma's named main route from M=0 at its source to M=620920 at Fredrikstad. Each retained route is checked for monotonic measures.
source.limitations: This is a river-line prototype, not terrain routing. Small/unrepresented streams and unmatched or ambiguous ends remain unavailable to drops; only routable=true lines reach their declared measured main-route outlet. Visual simplification retains every fixed junction.
source.selection: Whole measured river families for Nord-Norge; routes >=5 km or mapped catchment >=2 km².
source.title: NVE ELVIS · målte elveruter
